application_realization_envelope.narration: The baker shifts uncomfortably, wiping his hands on a cloth before glancing furtively around the bustling market. "I wish I could point you to a loaf without hesitation," they say quietly, "but sometimes, the choice you make here isn’t just about bread. Perhaps you'll find your own favorite once you've walked these streets a little longer."
